title: Add reusable Timekeeper agent
summary: Added a Timekeeper agent spec that keeps deadlines, timeboxes, critical path, schedule risk, and hurry-up trade-offs visible.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked Scrum timeboxes, Microsoft critical path, Atlassian scheduling, and PMI scheduling references.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.notes: Ran memory bootstrap and reviewed hot anchors.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.notes: Selected governance mode and reused agent-platform plus work-timer boundaries.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Added REQ-WS-064, specs, docs, source provenance, and plan evidence.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Added timekeeper-agent config, documentation, and history artifacts.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Ran agent inspection/list/orchestration, work-timer, unit tests, memory/config/docs checks, workspace maps, task board, workspace health, and monitor collect/test/check/build.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Ran omission, grounding, and work evaluator checks; wrote evaluation reports.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Commit and push are performed as the final close-out step.

bottleneck_notes: Governance artifacts and bilingual documentation dominate this agent-only change.
The reusable agent avoids a new timing runtime, reducing future maintenance cost.
improvement_candidates: If more schedule agents appear, create an agent-spec scaffold template for time/deadline roles.
